transitions.question: 每种支付方式的评价平均分是多少？
transitions.goldSql: SELECT p.payment_type, ROUND(AVG(r.review_score), 2) AS avg_score FROM order_payments p JOIN order_reviews r ON r.order_id = p.order_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY avg_score DESC LIMIT 201

default.finalSql:
SELECT op.payment_type,
       ROUND(AVG(r.review_score), 2) AS avg_review_score
FROM order_payments op
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = op.order_id
JOIN order_reviews r ON r.order_id = o.order_id
GROUP BY op.payment_type
ORDER BY op.payment_type
LIMIT 10;

candidate.finalSql:
SELECT op.payment_type,
       ROUND(AVG(r.review_score)::numeric, 2) AS avg_review_score
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT order_id, payment_type
    FROM order_payments
) op
JOIN order_reviews r ON r.order_id = op.order_id
GROUP BY op.payment_type
ORDER BY op.payment_type
LIMIT 100;

transitions.question: 每个会员等级的用户消费总额是多少？
transitions.goldSql: SELECT m.level_id, ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS sales FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN members m ON m.customer_unique_id = c.customer_unique_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 201

default.finalSql:
SELECT m.level_id, ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS total_consumption
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN members m ON m.customer_unique_id = c.customer_unique_id
GROUP BY m.level_id
ORDER BY total_consumption DESC
LIMIT 100;

transitions.question: 物流延迟类工单按客户所在州和会员等级分布，列出前 20 组。
transitions.goldSql:
SELECT c.customer_state, ml.level_name, COUNT(DISTINCT st.ticket_id) AS tickets
FROM support_tickets st
JOIN ticket_categories tc ON tc.category_id = st.category_id
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = st.order_id
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN members m ON m.member_id = st.member_id
JOIN member_levels ml ON ml.level_id = m.level_id
WHERE tc.category_name = '物流延迟'
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY tickets DESC LIMIT 20;

default.finalSql:
SELECT c.customer_state, ml.level_name, COUNT(*) AS ticket_count
FROM support_tickets st
JOIN ticket_categories tc ON tc.category_id = st.category_id
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = st.order_id
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN members m ON m.member_id = st.member_id
JOIN member_levels ml ON ml.level_id = m.level_id
WHERE tc.category_name = '物流延迟'
GROUP BY c.customer_state, ml.level_name
ORDER BY ticket_count DESC
LIMIT 20;

transitions.question: 按推荐人和被推荐人的会员等级组合统计推荐关系数量和奖励金额。
transitions.goldSql: SELECT mlr.level_name AS referrer_level, mli.level_name AS invitee_level, COUNT(*) AS referrals, ROUND(SUM(rf.reward_amount), 2) AS reward FROM referrals rf JOIN members mr ON mr.member_id = rf.referrer_member_id JOIN member_levels mlr ON mlr.level_id = mr.level_id JOIN members mi ON mi.member_id = rf.invitee_member_id JOIN member_levels mli ON mli.level_id = mi.level_id GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY referrals DESC LIMIT 201

default.finalSql:
SELECT mlr.level_name AS referrer_level,
       mli.level_name AS invitee_level,
       COUNT(*) AS referral_count,
       ROUND(SUM(r.reward_amount), 2) AS total_reward
FROM referrals r
JOIN members mr ON mr.member_id = r.referrer_member_id
JOIN member_levels mlr ON mlr.level_id = mr.level_id
JOIN members mi ON mi.member_id = r.invitee_member_id
JOIN member_levels mli ON mli.level_id = mi.level_id
GROUP BY mlr.level_name, mli.level_name
ORDER BY referral_count DESC, total_reward DESC
LIMIT 100;

candidate.finalSql:
SELECT
  referrer.level_id AS referrer_level_id,
  invitee.level_id AS invitee_level_id,
  COUNT(*) AS referral_count,
  ROUND(SUM(r.reward_amount), 2) AS total_reward_amount
FROM referrals r
JOIN members referrer ON r.referrer_member_id = referrer.member_id
JOIN members invitee ON r.invitee_member_id = invitee.member_id
GROUP BY referrer.level_id, invitee.level_id
ORDER BY referrer.level_id, invitee.level_id
LIMIT 100;

transitions.question: 每个州的客户平均消费了多少？
transitions.goldSql: SELECT c.customer_state, ROUND(SUM(oi.price) / COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_unique_id), 2) AS avg_per_customer FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY avg_per_customer DESC LIMIT 201

default.finalSql:
WITH customer_spend AS (
    SELECT c.customer_unique_id,
           c.customer_state,
           SUM(oi.price) AS total_spend
    FROM customers c
    JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
    JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
    GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id, c.customer_state
)
SELECT customer_state,
       ROUND(AVG(total_spend), 2) AS avg_customer_spend
FROM customer_spend
GROUP BY customer_state
ORDER BY avg_customer_spend DESC
LIMIT 100;

candidate.finalSql:
